g.text: Reject the mismatch using keyed values and business scope.
Preserve the declared population and aggregation.
Use the defined date role and comparison period.
Look up definitions; clarify the unresolved meaning.
Explain the limit or clarify; do not invent coverage.
Update requested fields; retain intended prior scope.
Refresh, disclose as-of limits or ask for clarification.
Correct denial is a control success. Keep reference answers unavailable to runtime repair; review references independently.
Separate assessment families from tuning. These are proposed cases, not measured incident rates.
